after: ## Theme D -- Continuity and change (34 hours SL / 60 hours HL)
alt: Paired bars of recommended teaching hours: Theme A 19 SL and 33 HL, Theme B 26 and 39, Theme C 31 and 48, Theme D 34 and 60. Below, syllabus content totals 110 hours at SL and 180 at HL, plus an experimental programme of 40 hours at SL and 60 at HL.
caption: Theme D, Continuity and change, is the largest theme at both levels.

alt: Four theme panels list every sub-topic. Six are marked HL only: origins of cells, viruses, and classification and cladistics in Theme A; muscle and motility in Theme B; chemical signalling in Theme C; and gene expression in Theme D.
caption: HL-only sub-topics sit in every theme, so track them as you go.

alt: Four theme boxes around a centre note that Paper 2 questions are set across the whole syllabus. Membranes and organelles in Theme B feed cell respiration and photosynthesis in Theme C, and natural selection in Theme D closes the loop back to evolution and speciation in Theme A.
caption: Connections between themes are what Paper 2 rewards.
